limitations: Diagnostic status only, not a formal experiment denominator. Preserved robots have different validation scopes; A4 scoring/observation corrections split the fresh runs into pre/post-correction cohorts.

SO-101 repair_3 was interrupted by a real Holistic DNS error; only repair_2 was fully validated. No automatic restart, resume or additional repair is claimed. Later Holistic calls succeeded, so this is an unresolved historical interruption, not a current global API outage.

H1 attempted all three repair calls. The recorded effective_repairs field is 1 because only repair_3 yielded a driver; this does not authorize two further repairs. It passed actual two-second standing but failed full Framework at humanoid_walk.
Unitree A1 final repair_3 lacks build(); its last physical round repair_2 was 1/10. A final build failure is not ten executed physical failures.
Unitree A1 and ANYmal-C G1-G3 reference positive-control gaps remain. These failures cannot be attributed solely to the generated drivers.

Kinova final construction steps two extra MjData instances for gripper calibration outside recorded capability trace/video. Capability execution is canonical; all physical execution cannot be claimed to use one recorded world.
UR5e self-reports no_contact, while canonical MuJoCo records sustained target contact. Trusted first failing gate is surface relative speed, not absence of physical contact.

A4 old-trace rescoring preserved original results. SO-101 nominal reference surface speed remains above its limit; some old reference traces cannot be rescored due to inconsistent timestamps. See the A4 correction report.
Token totals cover these ten fresh robot runs including returned calls before interruption; preserved five, reference controls and offline rescores are excluded. Actual cost is unavailable and null.

Wall-time totals are the sum of recorded pipeline wall clocks, not pure inference time or overall project elapsed time. SO-101 clock discrepancy and the recovered 2628-second H1 call interval remain documented.
Recorded Framework physics totals exclude generation probes and other uninstrumented settling/constructor simulations. H1 records two seconds of stand, not all home/squat/walk physics.
Full initial HTTP model requests are not in the existing JSONL traces. Model actions, observations, usage and durations are retained; public-input injection is supported by source/run-context review.
Large physical traces/videos remain local; compact candidate, Study, generation/repair traces, metrics and reports are committed. No remote push.
